Audit.title: Shiga Masanin Oracle
Audit.subtitle: Kasance tare da cibiyar sadarwar kwararru da aka tabbatar. Binciki ayyukan samar da ababen more rayuwa na jama'a ta amfani da takaddun shaidar ku na cryptographic don tabbatar da lissafi da gaskiya.
Audit.review_desc: Bincika ayyukan ababen more rayuwa da al'umma suka tabbatar.
Audit.no_projects: A halin yanzu babu wasu ayyukan da ke jiran binciken masani.
Audit.enter_value_desc: Bisa ga shaidar hoto da aka gabatar da kimar injiniya.
Audit.note_placeholder: Bayyana bincikenku. Wannan bayanin za a sa hannu a kai ta walat dinku kuma zai zama bayyane ga jama'a.
Audit.generating_signature: Ana samar da sa hannun cryptographic...
Audit.signed_success: An sa hannu kan bincike ta hanyar cryptographic kuma an mika shi ga cibiyar sadarwa!
Audit.sign_failed: Ba a sami nasarar sa hannu kan bincike ba.

HowItWorks.subtitle: Wani tsarin da ya haɗa talakawa da kwararru don tabbatar da gaskiya kan kashe kudaden ababen more rayuwa.
HowItWorks.step1_desc: CivicSpend tana binciken bayanan gwamnati ta atomatik don samun sababbin ayyuka. Jama'a kuma suna iya bada rahoto da kansu.
HowItWorks.step1_found: An samu: Titin Lagos-Ibadan Kashi na 2
HowItWorks.step2_desc: Jama'a suna ɗaukar hotuna kuma suna bayar da bayanai. Ba kwa buƙatar asusu - tsarinmu na hana zamba yana ba ku damar jefa kuri'a.
HowItWorks.step2_quote: "Tushen kawai aka aza. Babu ma'aikata tun ranar Talata."
HowItWorks.step2_time: An dora awanni 2 da suka wuce
HowItWorks.step3_desc: Al'umma tana duba hujjoji kuma ta jefa kuri'a. Idan an samu kuri'u masu yawa, ana tura aikin ga kwararru.
HowItWorks.step4_desc: Kwararru masu lasisi za su duba shaidun kuma su sa hannu kan bambancin kasafin kudi don a adana shi tabbatacce.
HowItWorks.cta_desc: Fara ta duba ayyukan al'umma ko shigar da hujjoji sababbi.
